Council

			
        
    
                    


    



 
Council Meetings are held on the fourth Wednesday of each month in the Phil Barry Chamber, Wakefield Regional Council, Balaklava.
All Council Meetings start at 5:00pm.
The schedule for 2026  is as follows:
  • 28 January 2026
  • 25 February 2026
  • 25 March 2026
  • 22 April  2026
  • 27 May 2026
  • 24 June 2026
  • 22 July 2026
  • 26 August 2026
  • 23 September 2026
  • 28 October 2026
  • 25 November 2026
  • December 2026  (TBA)
As part of our commitment to transparency, we record our Council meetings. Audio files for each meeting will be included below once the Minutes have been circulated.
Click on the links below to listen to the relevant Council meeting.  Please note that the audio files are quite large and may take some time to download.

Council

			
        
    
                    


    



 
Council Meetings are held on the fourth Wednesday of each month in the Phil Barry Chamber, Wakefield Regional Council, Balaklava.
All Council Meetings start at 5:00pm.
The schedule for 2026  is as follows:
  • 28 January 2026
  • 25 February 2026
  • 25 March 2026
  • 22 April  2026
  • 27 May 2026
  • 24 June 2026
  • 22 July 2026
  • 26 August 2026
  • 23 September 2026
  • 28 October 2026
  • 25 November 2026
  • December 2026  (TBA)

Mid North Regional Assessment Panel

			
        
    
                    


    



Under the new Planning, Development and Infrastructure Act 2016 (PDI Act), the Council Assessment Panel has been replaced by the Mid North Regional Assessment Panel.
The Mid North Regional Assessment Panel includes Wakefield Regional Council, Clare & Gilbert Valleys Council, Regional Council of Goyder and Northern Areas Council. Meetings are scheduled monthly on the fourth Thursday of the month in the Clare & Gilbert Valleys Council Chambers at 6pm. If the agenda lacks content, the meeting will be postponed to the following month.
Please click on the links to view the Code of Conduct, Meeting Procedures and Terms of Reference.
To access agendas and minutes prior to 31 July 2020, click here.
